title_vi: Tìm quán gần bạn bằng geohash: chia ô, so tiền tố, và chỗ nó sót

source_snapshot.note: Pinned commit/path body read from raw.githubusercontent.com at the pinned commit and hashed as a Git blob; computed OID matches the source map. Non-empty source was read; no source-image bytes used.

mobile.reason: figure drawn by scripts/figures; the non-browser python3 -m scripts.figures check passes, but the browser measurement (--browser) and a whole-lesson check at 320, 375 and 430 px were not run because the sandbox browser build is unavailable

claims.claim_vi: The source splits the system into a Business Service (add, delete, update, view restaurants) and a Location-based Service (given a radius and location return nearby restaurants); proposes geohash: divide the planet into four quadrants along the prime meridian and equator with one bit per half, divide each cell into four, alternate longitude and latitude bits, then query WHERE geohash LIKE a prefix; notes that one cell may hold many restaurants and another none.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Own experiment, 2026-10-19, Python 3: own geohash implementation (longitude bit first); Hanoi 21.0285 N 105.8542 E gives w7er8u; 57.64911 N 10.40744 E gives u4pruydqqvj; cell sizes near 21 degrees latitude: length 4 about 36.5 x 19.6 km, 5 about 4.57 x 4.89 km, 6 about 1.14 x 0.61 km, 7 about 0.14 x 0.15 km.
claims.verified_by: Script run in the session; results copied from output. The u4pruydqqvj example is recalled from general knowledge and not checked against a reference.

claims.claim_vi: Own experiment: 21,500 synthetic places (20,000 uniform over about 20 x 20 km plus 1,500 in a 1 x 1 km cluster), 300 random searchers, radius 1 km, 55,139 true matches in total; length 5 with only the searcher's cell missed 15.7 percent and scanned 1,261 places per query, with the nine cells missed 0 percent and scanned 9,244; length 6 with one cell missed 79.1 percent and scanned 40, with nine cells missed 6.5 percent and scanned 380; a full scan reads 21,500; the densest length-5 cell held 2,588 places.
claims.verified_by: Script run in the session with a fixed seed; results copied from output.

claims.claim_vi: The geohash bit layout, base-32 alphabet and cell-size formulas are the author's general knowledge and were not matched against a standard document.
claims.verified_by: Author's general knowledge, not checked against the primary document in this session (the egress proxy allows GitHub only).

design_notes_vi: Khung một là bốn bước từ tọa độ tới mã; khung hai là ba ghi chú từ thử nghiệm. Hai bảng thử nghiệm nằm trong bài.
source_deviations: The source gives the idea and one limitation; the lesson adds cell-size measurements and a recall test for one cell versus nine cells at two code lengths.
The source's bit-order wording lists latitude first; the lesson follows the common longitude-first layout, which is the author's general knowledge.
editorial_note_vi: Bài mới viết tại repo này (gói W19), giữ ở trạng thái draft chờ review kỹ thuật. Chưa user testing hoặc phê duyệt phát hành.
